access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-6 Luna release of September 22, 2026 as exposed under the gpt-6-luna name: OpenAI's model page lists the default snapshot and the snapshot inventory as gpt-6-luna with no dated snapshot, so applications cannot pin a dated revision through OpenAI, although Azure Foundry documents the version as gpt-6-luna (2026-09-22). OpenAI changed the name in place on September 25, 2026 (an image-encoding fix). The GPT-5.6 Luna tier, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT and Codex surfaces, the Decisions API that OpenAI released with this model, fine-tuned derivatives, and later generations are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI's changelog pins the September 22, 2026 release, the model page documents modalities, limits, endpoints, and rate limits, and the model catalog lists it among the current GPT-6 models
The deprecations table names the model as the replacement for gpt-5.4-nano, and Azure Foundry documents a dated version with no access request
tradeoffs: OpenAI documents no fixed dated snapshot and changed the name's behavior in place on September 25, 2026, so the record cannot pin behavior the way dated-snapshot records can
No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
